subject: I
fact: The party spread toward its separate concerns the way a held breath spreads into air, each of us expanding slightly into the space the Underdark had compressed out of us.
source_quote: The party spread toward its separate concerns the way a held breath spreads into air, each of us expanding slightly into the space the Underdark had compressed out of us.

subject: I
fact: The weeks that followed blurred in the way that recovery blurs — not forgetting, exactly, but the edges going soft.
source_quote: The weeks that followed blurred in the way that recovery blurs — not forgetting, exactly, but the edges going soft.

subject: I
fact: We agreed on the gear.
source_quote: We agreed on the gear.

subject: I
fact: We stood in the Overbright for a while, longer than was probably necessary from a tactical standpoint, and nobody suggested moving immediately.
source_quote: We stood in the Overbright for a while, longer than was probably necessary from a tactical standpoint, and nobody suggested moving immediately.

subject: I
fact: We were a group that moved quickly, that had learned to move quickly, that treated stillness as the thing you did when stillness was the only remaining option.
source_quote: We were a group that moved quickly, that had learned to move quickly, that treated stillness as the thing you did when stillness was the only remaining option.

subject: Ilvara’s disappearance
fact: Ilvara vanished without warning, leaving behind a trail of corrupted texts and unanswered communications; her absence triggered urgent inquiries from House Mizzrym and silence from Neverlight Grove, revealing the fragility of her political and religious roles.
source_quote: You've gone missing. Followed by more frantic: where are you, where are you? Didn't you read the previous memo? What's up?

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira applauded Zalthir's killing of Asha Vandree as a necessary act.
source_quote: Well done, well done, well done! See, he wasn't completely defenseless.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira clarified that the contract was to prevent other drow factions from killing Daz.
source_quote: Our terms of our contract were to make sure that the other drow factions didn't get you killed.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira noted that the T'sarran goons were to be handled personally if needed.
source_quote: They'd been prepared to handle the T'sarran contingent personally if it came to that.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira noticed the anomaly of Daz being protected despite having no noble house or lineage.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira observed that Thorin and the party had made it this far despite their flawed methods.
source_quote: It's amazing that you people have made it this far.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira said the three bravos were not sincere.
source_quote: Three *bravos*. I have found, as a general principle, that a third *bravo* is never sincere.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira said they were not paid to think too hard about Daz's identity.
source_quote: Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.

subject: looting Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree's body was looted, yielding a holy symbol of Lolth, chain mail, prayer beads, and a sealed wax pouch.
source_quote: I looted her with the efficient respect one extends to a theological problem that has been resolved. The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: Looting of Asha Vandree's remains
fact: The efficient looting of Asha Vandree’s body marked the closure of a theological anomaly — her identity as a cleric of two incompatible deities resolved through death.
source_quote: I looted her with the efficient respect one extends to a theological problem that has been resolved.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym criticized Thorin for not killing Asha Vandree immediately.
source_quote: When attacking a cleric of Lolth, Thorin, one does not just simply grapple them. One takes your blade and cuts their heads off.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym dismissed the threat of Asha Vandree as insignificant compared to Daz's survival.
source_quote: If Daz can't protect himself from a low-level cult initiate of Lolth, then quite frankly, whoever paid for his survival deserves to lose his money.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym stated that the fee for protecting Daz is a price Daz cannot afford.
source_quote: That is a fee... that is a price you cannot afford.

subject: Nym and Kaelira's departure
fact: Nym and Kaelira depart professionally after concluding their contract is fulfilled.
source_quote: The sisters departed. Professionally. Without ceremony. The contract was fulfilled; they were done.

subject: opening of the bag of holding
fact: Grygum opened the bag of holding, allowing Glabbagool to emerge into sunlight for the first time, triggering an unprecedented reaction of curiosity in the ooze and revealing a vulnerability in the group’s logistics.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward... had peered out.

subject: opening the wax pouch
fact: The sealed wax pouch was opened and revealed a theological manuscript claiming Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same.
source_quote: The seal broke cleanly. Inside were pages of close, careful script — the handwriting of someone who had once been methodical... I read far enough to understand what it was...

subject: purchase of adventuring gear
fact: The party agreed to spend their surplus gold on adventuring gear rather than business ventures, reasoning that gear reduces consequences of danger and infrastructure or stability were not yet earned.
source_quote: We agreed on the gear.

subject: Purification Attempt with Dawnbringer
fact: A proposed ritual purification using Dawnbringer was rejected by the blade, leading to a negotiated compromise facilitated by Thorin’s use of the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard.
source_quote: I suppose… I could do you this one. I could do this solid for you.

subject: reading sealed orders from House Mizzrym
fact: The sealed orders from House Mizzrym were read aloud, revealing urgent inquiries about Ilvara's disappearance.
source_quote: I read them aloud, more or less: 'Where are you? What have you been doing? Respond — kind of thing. You've gone missing. Followed by more frantic: where are you, where are you? Didn't you read the previous memo? What's up?'

subject: recovering the Living Serpent Head Scourge
fact: The Living Serpent Head Scourge was set aside as a museum piece after being found on Ilvara's body.
source_quote: I set it aside with the other items. The prayer book. The wax pouch. The sealed orders. The serpent scourge.

subject: rest duration
fact: They rested for a long night.
source_quote: a long rest

subject: retrieving Thorin's tooth
fact: Thorin retrieved his tooth from the confiscated prisoner belongings chest.
source_quote: He reached in and found it.

subject: ritual duration
fact: Ilvara had spent months allowing fungal growth to become something wrong.
source_quote: the fungal growth that had crept up the stone was still pulsing with Zuggtmoy's reach, slow and rhythmic like breathing, and Grygum was not the sort to leave corruption breathing. ... the fungal matter that had spent months becoming something wrong collapsed into ash

subject: second day
fact: The session occurs on the second day of the Tenday.
source_quote: 2nd Tenday

subject: sequence marker
fact: It was the third time the group had encountered such corruption.
source_quote: third time

subject: sequence marker
fact: This was the first time they had found such a journal.
source_quote: first time

subject: sequence of decision-making
fact: Daz's conclusion about going to Candlekeep was reached before the group discussion began.
source_quote: the conclusion — Candlekeep... was reasonable... was already pulling it toward a conclusion before the conversation began

subject: sequence of emergence
fact: Thorin emerged first, Grygum second, Daz last, and the rest followed.
source_quote: Thorin first... Grygum next... Daz came through last... The rest of our moltley crew followed

subject: silencing of Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree was rendered permanently silent by a swift, precise lethal strike from the narrator's Eldritch Claw Tattoo. The silence that followed was the kind that follows a decision you can't walk back.
source_quote: Asha Vandree did not get another word out.

subject: theological manuscript discovery
fact: A theological manuscript was discovered arguing that Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same being — a conclusion reached by backward reasoning from a desired outcome.
source_quote: It's basically a long theological exploration of why Zuggtmoy and Lolth — and claiming that Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same thing... It was very well-argued. It was also completely mad.

subject: third bravo
fact: The third 'bravo' is spoken and is not sincere.
source_quote: Bravo, bravo, bravo.

subject: third round
fact: The confrontation with Asha Vandree occurs after the third round of conflict escalation.
source_quote: I stepped in.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked what it would cost to retain the sisters.
source_quote: He asked what it would cost.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin grappled Asha Vandree to prevent her from speaking.
source_quote: He crossed the distance and got his hands on her — properly, a full grapple, one hand clamped over her mouth before she could invoke anything else.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin looked up and something shifted in his face — recognition, and then something quieter beneath it.
source_quote: Thorin looked up. Something shifted in his face — recognition, and then something quieter beneath it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin reached in and found the tooth and held it for a moment without saying anything.
source_quote: He reached in and found it. He held it for a moment without saying anything.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'Oh, yeah. I want my tooth back.'
source_quote: Oh, yeah. I want my tooth back.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'Very sentimental.'
source_quote: Very sentimental.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin stood with his face at an angle that suggested he was calculating the sun's position relative to the year.
source_quote: Thorin stood with his face at an angle that suggested he was calculating the sun's position relative to the year.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin collected gold, short swords, a long sword, and a steel whistle from the dead guards.
source_quote: Gold, short swords, a long sword, a steel whistle.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin confirmed the contract was from House T'sarran to extract Daz alive and unharmed.
source_quote: There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin examined the partially burned documents revealing the contract to extract Daz alive and unharmed.
source_quote: Then the documents. They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it, which meant the information in them was exactly the kind of thing worth knowing.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin heard Daz respond to Nym with, 'So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?'
source_quote: Daz looked at her with something behind his eyes that I couldn't quite read. He let a beat pass, and then he said: 'So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin heard Kaelira say, 'Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.'
source_quote: Kaelira said, without looking up from the documents: 'Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin heard Nym question Daz's mysterious origins and the cost of the contract.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody. Do you know how much money that required us to get, for us to do? A lot. Like, they interrupt you. A lot.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin identified the stitched cloth as Ilvara's madness made physical.
source_quote: It was evidence. It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin noted Dawnbringer's concession: 'I suppose I could do you this one. I could do this solid for you.'
source_quote: I suppose…" Dawnbringer began, and then, with the dignity of someone granting a significant concession: "I suppose I could do you this one. I could do this solid for you.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin observed Daz's reaction to the questions about his identity as restrained.
source_quote: Which was, I thought, the most restrained thing he could possibly have said in that moment.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin observed Nym's expressive irritation and Kaelira's professional stillness as they read the documents.
source_quote: Nym had the kind of face that gets more expressive the more irritated she becomes, and right now she was very expressive. Kaelira was the opposite — still and professional, reading the burned pages with the focus of someone who was paid to be good at exactly this.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin observed the comfortable rhythm of repetition between himself and Dawnbringer.
source_quote: They had been here before, the dwarf and his sword. They would be here again.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin passed through the bodies of the dead soldiers of House Mizzrym without praying.
source_quote: I didn't pray over them. They'd come here doing what they were told by someone who had already lost her mind, and I had nothing to say to them that wasn't just 'better luck in another life.'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin pocketed the incense cones, silver bowl, and stitched cloth bearing Lolth's web and Zuggtmoy's mark.
source_quote: Inside: incense cones, a silver bowl small enough to fit in one hand, and a cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin recognized the T'sarran signet ring on the dead mage’s finger.
source_quote: I found the signet ring first — House T'sarran, the seal unmistakable on the face of it.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin recognized the necromantic pearl as something deliberately placed, not accidental.
source_quote: The pearl wasn't in the wrong place by accident. Someone had put something like it there, or something like it had grown there because the conditions were exactly right for it.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin retrieved Ilvara's tooth from her trophy collection.
source_quote: She'd taken my tooth. A chip broken off in the capture, displayed in her chest like a piece of evidence of what she could do.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin saw Daz reach for the wand — obsidian with a captive spider in amber — and noted its significance.
source_quote: Then the wand: obsidian, a captive spider preserved in amber at its tip.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin showed the documents to Nym and Kaelira.
source_quote: We showed the documents to Nym and Kaelira.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin used the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard to persuade Dawnbringer to participate in the ritual.
source_quote: Thorin reached, unhurriedly, for the scabbard. 'Do I need to show you the scabbard again?'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin watched Daz and Dawnbringer negotiate the use of the sunblade in a purification ritual.
source_quote: Dawnbringer disagreed. 'I'm not some kind of magical wizard thingy that purifies things. I am a high-quality sunblade. I kill things. I will not be treated like a religious symbol to be used and waved over corrupt—'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin wrapped up the incense cones, silver bowl, and stitched cloth before moving on.
source_quote: I wrapped it back up and moved on.

subject: Thorin's grapple of Asha
fact: Thorin grapples Asha Vandree and covers her mouth to prevent her from speaking.
source_quote: Thorin crossed the distance and got his hands on her — properly, a full grapple, one hand clamped over her mouth before she could invoke anything else.

subject: travel duration
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.

subject: travel duration to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir decided to act decisively when others hesitated.
source_quote: I'm making a call," I said. I stepped in.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir did not look at Asha Vandree's body after killing her.
source_quote: I didn't look at the body.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir killed Asha Vandree to prevent her from invoking Lolth's power.
source_quote: The Eldritch Claw Tattoo doesn't announce itself. One moment I was behind her, the next my hands were something else — longer, reaching — and the strikes came in sequence... Asha Vandree did not get another word out.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recalled a class on decisive action under moral uncertainty.
source_quote: There was a class for this. Decisive action under moral uncertainty — the ethics of necessary violence, or something like that.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and Grygum did not begrudge him that.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Duskryns
fact: Duskryns were hired as cutouts in a mystery involving Daz's history.
source_quote: whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history

subject: Duskryns
fact: Hired Duskryns are acting as cutouts or intermediaries in a shadow network pointing toward Daz's past, their purpose unclear but their trail significant enough to warrant investigation.
source_quote: whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history

subject: Duskryns
fact: The Duskryns are hired agents whose activities point toward deeper implications regarding Daz's history; they are being investigated alongside House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance.
source_quote: whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: A drow house unaware of Ilvara’s subversion — their frantic communications reveal a political structure blind to internal theological collapse.
source_quote: House Mizzrym would learn eventually, I supposed. We had helped with that.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym deployed soldiers to the chamber where Ilvara conducted her rituals; their corpses were found with weapons and insignia, suggesting they were part of a failed enforcement or guard detail.
source_quote: The dead soldiers of House Mizzrym would never collect their pay.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym employed a contingent of soldiers who were killed in the chamber; their bodies bore gold, short swords, a long sword, and a steel whistle, but their pay will never be collected.
source_quote: The dead soldiers of House Mizzrym would never collect their pay.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym is a Drow noble house in Menzoberranzan that has targeted Daz for elimination. It is one of two primary threats named in the mercenary contract, indicating active hostility toward him.
source_quote: House Mizzrym. House T'sarran. Those were the parameters.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym is one of the Drow houses identified as a threat to Daz.
source_quote: Two threats named, she said. House Mizzrym. House T'sarran.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym is one of the two noble houses in Menzoberranzan identified as a threat to Daz; the mercenaries were contracted to prevent them from killing him.
source_quote: House Mizzrym. House T'sarran. Those were the parameters.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym maintained formal communication with Ilvara and is now discovering her disappearance; their urgency reveals a dependency on her role, and their eventual reckoning will confront the unexplained collapse of a key agent.
source_quote: House Mizzrym would learn eventually, I supposed. We had helped with that.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym sent sealed orders seeking Ilvara's whereabouts after her disappearance.
source_quote: The sealed orders from House Mizzrym were more immediately practical... 'Where are you? What have you been doing? Respond — kind of thing.'

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: The dead guards belonged to House Mizzrym.
source_quote: The dead soldiers of House Mizzrym would never collect their pay.

subject: House Mizzrym members
fact: House Mizzrym had sent three envoys to investigate.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran commissioned a contract to extract Daz alive and unharmed, using professional Drow mercenaries and routing the order through a house with sufficient reach to ensure execution; they are directly implicated in the events of the chamber.
source_quote: House T'sarran behind it.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran commissioned the contract to extract Daz alive and unharmed.
source_quote: House T'sarran behind it.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran contracted professional Drow mercenaries to extract Daz alive and unharmed, indicating significant resources and reach behind the operation.
source_quote: There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran is a Drow noble house in Menzoberranzan that has targeted Daz for elimination. It is one of two primary threats named in the mercenary contract, and the Duskryn sisters indicated they were prepared to handle its agents personally if needed.
source_quote: House Mizzrym. House T'sarran. Those were the parameters.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran is one of the Drow houses identified as a threat to Daz.
source_quote: Two threats named, she said. House Mizzrym. House T'sarran.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran is the second noble house identified as a threat to Daz; the mercenaries were prepared to handle them personally if necessary, but Daz eliminated their goons himself.
source_quote: We'd just finished burning. ... They'd been prepared to handle the T'sarran contingent personally if it came to that.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran is the target of Daz's research; its connection to Jimjar's disappearance and the Duskryns' activities is being investigated as part of a larger inquiry into Daz's own past.
source_quote: research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran is the target of research at Candlekeep, linked to Jimjar's disappearance and the activities of hired Duskryns, suggesting a hidden conspiracy tied to Daz's origins.
source_quote: research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history

subject: Ilvara's House
fact: Ilvara's House is a Drow noble house referenced as a threat to Daz, though it was not directly named in the final contract terms. The Duskryn sisters imply it was initially considered a danger, but Daz’s own actions neutralized it.
source_quote: We hoped that you'd be smart enough to avoid Ilvara... well, we could have handled House T'sarran and whatever goons they threw at you.

subject: Ilvara's House
fact: Ilvara's House is referenced as an additional threat to Daz, though not named explicitly as a noble house; the mercenaries were hired to protect him from them as well.
source_quote: Hired to protect me — specifically, me — from Ilvara's House and from the T'sarran goons...

subject: Lolth Cult (Asha)
fact: Asha is a Lolth cultist devotedly faithful and genuinely unaware of Daz’s true nature. She is dismissed by the Duskryn sisters as a trivial threat — a low-level initiate whose elimination would require seconds, not strategy.
source_quote: If Daz can't protect himself from a low-level cult initiate of Lolth, then quite frankly, whoever paid for his survival deserves to lose his money.

subject: Lolth Cult (Asha's Affiliation)
fact: Asha Vandree’s devotion to Lolth is presented as genuine, though her interpretation of divine favor is dangerously delusional; her cultic authority is perceived as a lethal threat by Zalthir and the Drow mercenaries.
source_quote: I am blessed by Lolth!

subject: Lolth's clergy
fact: Clerics of Lolth are feared for their ability to curse, command, and pray even under physical restraint. Their survival depends on vocal invocation — meaning silence is the only true neutralization.
source_quote: A Lolth cleric with her mouth uncovered is a Lolth cleric who can pray, command, curse — and a grapple, however competent, doesn't hold forever.

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: In Menzoberranzan, that level of insulation around a financial transaction means exactly one thing: the payer has significant reason not to be associated with the purchase. Which means the purchase is either embarrassing, illegal, or dangerous to be seen making.
source_quote: In Menzoberranzan, that level of insulation around a financial transaction means exactly one thing: the payer has significant reason not to be associated with the purchase. Which means the purchase is either embarrassing, illegal, or dangerous to be seen making.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: A political entity whose alliance with Ilvara dissolved without notice — evidence that Zuggtmoy’s influence overrode even formal diplomatic ties.
source_quote: Political correspondence that had gone nowhere, because the person it was addressed to had gone somewhere else — somewhere a Demon Queen's influence had been a stronger pull than any political alliance.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: Neverlight Grove attempted to maintain political ties with Ilvara, but their correspondence failed due to her absence; their loss reflects the fragility of alliances when a figure is consumed by a greater, hidden power.
source_quote: A missed meeting. Political correspondence that had gone nowhere, because the person it was addressed to had gone somewhere else — somewhere a Demon Queen's influence had been a stronger pull than any political alliance.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: Neverlight Grove sent a letter to Ilvara referencing a missed meeting.
source_quote: The letter from Neverlight Grove completed the picture... A missed meeting. Political correspondence that had gone nowhere...

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is a location through which the speaker carried the concept of the Overbright.
source_quote: The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep has pamphlets available for Grygum to read.
source_quote: Candlekeep was going to be, for him, something between research and pilgrimage. He would look up the lore of Bahamut. He would pick up pamphlets.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep is the Great Library where the group plans to conduct research.
source_quote: The conclusion — Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance...

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep, the Great Library, is the chosen destination for research into House T'sarran, Jimjar's disappearance, Daz's history, and Bahamutian lore, serving as both intellectual hub and spiritual sanctuary for the group.
source_quote: Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance...

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep, the Great Library, is the group's chosen destination; it is seen as a source of information on House T'sarran, Jimjar, the Duskryns, Bahamut, and the lore of the surface world.
source_quote: Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance...

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber contains a fungal mass at its center, a stone platform covered in pulsing fungal growth, and dead guards.
source_quote: The fungal mass sat at the center of the chamber... The bundle was underneath... The guards hadn't survived

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber has a stone platform that was built by Ilvara and covered in fungal growth.
source_quote: Ilvara had built herself something elevated... the fungal growth that had crept up the stone was still pulsing with Zuggtmoy's reach

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber is the current location where the speaker has paused to observe, check their pocket, and prepare to move on, with the smell of scorched rot lingering as an unresolved question.
source_quote: We still had a chamber to clear... and the smell of scorched rot hanging in the air like a question that hadn't finished resolving itself.

subject: chamber dimensions
fact: The fungal mass sat at the center of the chamber.
source_quote: The fungal mass sat at the center of the chamber

subject: Chamber of Ilvara's Ritual
fact: A corrupted chamber where Ilvara fused the symbols of Zuggtmoy and Lolth into a fungal ritual nexus, producing the necromantic pearl and attracting House T'sarran’s interest.
source_quote: The fungal mass sat at the center of the chamber the way a problem sits at the center of a bad situation — obvious, unavoidable, radiating something wrong in every direction.

subject: Darklake
fact: Darklake is a location through which the speaker carried the concept of the Overbright.
source_quote: The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone

subject: Drow Outpost
fact: A site of theological decay — where prisoner belongings, prayer books, and treatises reveal the collapse of drow religious hierarchy under Zuggtmoy's influence.
source_quote: A cleric's catalogue of the things a high priestess of Lolth becomes when something older and stranger finds the seam in her theology and begins to work.

subject: Drow outpost
fact: The Drow outpost contained a jailer's ring, a chest of coin, a prisoner belongings chest, a water-damaged journal, a flask of brandy, Asha Vandree's remains, Ilvara's body, and various documents and artifacts.
source_quote: The keys were the first thing I noticed... The payroll was next... Then I saw the other chest... We also found a water-damaged journal... The flask of Overbright brandy... Asha Vandree's body was next... Ilvara's prayer book was still on the body... The sealed orders from House Mizzrym... The letter from Neverlight Grove... The last item was on Ilvara herself.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a location through which the speaker carried the concept of the Overbright.
source_quote: The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone

subject: Labyrinth dimensions

fact: Grygum was the only one among us who had accumulated a list of things he wanted to read, and Candlekeep was going to be, for him, something between research and pilgrimage.
source_quote: Grygum had pamphlets on his mind. This was entirely consistent. Grygum was the only one among us who had accumulated a list of things he wanted to read, and Candlekeep was going to be, for him, something between research and pilgrimage.

subject: I
fact: I had been carrying the Overbright through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone like a stone in a pocket, something I reached for when the tunnels pressed too close.
source_quote: The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone like a stone in a pocket, something I reached for when the tunnels pressed too close.

subject: Ilvara
fact: A high priestess of Lolth whose theology was subverted by Zuggtmoy, evidenced by marginalia in her prayer book and her collection of prisoner trophies — including Thorin's tooth.
source_quote: She had been carrying his tooth around the Underdark. She had collected it like a curiosity.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara collected trophies from captives, including Thorin's tooth.
source_quote: When we'd first found ourselves hanging in nets at Velkynvelve, Ilvara had made a point of collecting trophies... she'd taken my tooth.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara collected trophies from her captives to establish a clear power dynamic, specifically taking a tooth from the speaker and displaying it as evidence of her dominance.
source_quote: she'd taken my tooth. A chip broken off in the capture, displayed in her chest like a piece of evidence of what she could do.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara had been carrying Thorin's tooth around the Underdark and collected it like a curiosity.
source_quote: she had been carrying his tooth around the Underdark. She had collected it like a curiosity.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is a Drow house whose agents were a threat to Daz.
source_quote: Hired to protect me — specifically, me — from Ilvara's House and from the T'sarran goons we'd just finished burning.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was a High Priestess who built rituals around a fused sigil of Lolth and Zuggtmoy, indicating her madness and dual allegiance to two conflicting deities; her physical artifacts were found as evidence of her transformation.
source_quote: It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was a high priestess of Lolth who carried prisoner belongings as trophies and was subverted by Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Confiscated prisoner belongings. Ilvara had been carrying it. Of course she had — she was exactly the sort of high priestess who would keep trophies, who would drag along evidence of her ownership of people the way some clerics keep relics.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was a high priestess of Lolth, ambitious and politically dangerous, who was slowly subverted by Zuggtmoy; the marginalia in her prayer book suggests she may have been aware of her own corruption — or may have believed she was still acting of her own will.
source_quote: She had not resisted it. I could not tell from the text whether she had known she wasn't resisting or whether she had genuinely believed she was still moving in her own direction. That ambiguity was the most troubling part.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara, a former High Priestess, used a fungal mass as a ritual anchor to merge the symbols of Zuggtmoy and Lolth, creating a corrupted nexus that produced a necromantic pearl, before being slain by Grygum.
source_quote: Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara, a high priestess, had been carrying the tooth of Thorin as a trophy — collecting it like a curiosity — before being killed by the narrator.
source_quote: Ilvara had been carrying it. Of course she had — she was exactly the sort of high priestess who would keep trophies, who would drag along evidence of her ownership of people the way some clerics keep relics... She had been carrying his tooth around the Underdark. She had collected it like a curiosity. I filed that under Ilvara, and closed the file, because she was already dead and I had killed her.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira believes Daz is likely suffering from daddy issues and self-mythologizing.
source_quote: Yes, yes, yes, that's what every orphan thinks. Do you have daddy issues? Do you have mommy issues? Every drow thinks there's some noble things.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira clapped slowly and deliberately after Asha's death, applauding the lethal action as a demonstration of capability. Her praise carried an undertone of critique and implied disbelief in the group's prior hesitation.
source_quote: Well done, well done, well done! See, he wasn't completely defenseless.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira is Nym’s sister and fellow mercenary; she displays acute professional confusion at the anomaly of Daz’s existence — a nobody worth massive investment — and her blunt assessments reveal a deep familiarity with the political calculus of Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: For all we know, this was a game being played by the houses.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira is a Drow mercenary who expresses professional confusion about why Daz was worth such a high payment.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira is the other Drow sister hired to extract Daz, and like Nym, she finds him either fascinating or ridiculous, having witnessed this kind of performance before.
source_quote: They had seen this particular performance before, apparently.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira reads the burned documents with professional focus.
source_quote: Kaelira was the opposite — still and professional, reading the burned pages with the focus of someone who was paid to be good at exactly this.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira, the other Duskryn sister, is professionally detached and methodical, prioritizing factual analysis over speculation, and offers the most honest assessment of their mission’s limitations.
source_quote: Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.

subject: Kaelira Duskryn
fact: Kaelira Duskryn is Nym’s sister and co-mercenary. She is analytically precise, professionally confused by Daz’s inexplicable value, and dismissive of his self-mythologizing. She assessed that Daz has no noble house, no lineage, and no known background — yet someone paid 'a lot' to protect him. She finds his existence an anomaly in the Drow power structure.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: male Drow apostate
fact: A male Drow apostate with no house affiliation and no apparent strategic value survived long enough to do whatever it was I was apparently supposed to do.
source_quote: a male Drow apostate with no house affiliation and no apparent strategic value survived long enough to do whatever it was I was apparently supposed to do.

subject: me
fact: I was a nobody. A nobody that someone in Menzoberranzan had interrupted their schedule over, more than once.
source_quote: Me. A nobody. A nobody that someone in Menzoberranzan had interrupted their schedule over, more than once.

subject: Milo Goodbarrel
fact: Milo Goodbarrel is a halfling whose book Daz read extensively and who coined the phrase 'standing at the edge of the question that changes everything.'
source_quote: Milo Goodbarrel, that relentlessly hopeful halfling whose book I'd read too many times to admit, had a phrase for the sensation I was experiencing.

subject: Milo Goodbarrel
fact: Milo Goodbarrel, that relentlessly hopeful halfling whose book I'd read too many times to admit, had a phrase for the sensation I was experiencing. He called it *standing at the edge of the question that changes everything.*
source_quote: Milo Goodbarrel, that relentlessly hopeful halfling whose book I'd read too many times to admit, had a phrase for the sensation I was experiencing. He called it *standing at the edge of the question that changes everything.*

subject: Nym
fact: Nym becomes more expressive when irritated.
source_quote: Nym had the kind of face that gets more expressive the more irritated she becomes

subject: Nym
fact: Nym criticized Thorin's grapple as inadequate against a Lolth cleric, asserting that the only proper response is to cut off the cleric's head. She made 'grapple' sound like a mild obscenity and questioned Thorin's competence.
source_quote: When attacking a cleric of Lolth, one does not just simply grapple them. One takes your blade and cuts their heads off.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym is a Drow mercenary from Menzoberranzan, part of a pair hired to protect Daz from House Mizzrym and House T'sarran; she exhibits professional detachment, understands the value of insulation in high-stakes contracts, and dismisses Daz’s self-mythologizing with cold pragmatism.
source_quote: That is a fee... that is a price you cannot afford.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym is a Drow mercenary hired to protect Daz from House Mizzrym and House T'sarran.
source_quote: Our terms of our contract were to make sure that the other drow factions didn't get you killed.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym is one of the Drow sisters hired through cutouts to extract Daz, and she regards him with a mix of interest and condescension, having seen similar cases of self-deluded Drow before.
source_quote: They had opinions, the sisters, about mysterious orphans who arrive at adulthood convinced they have noble blood waiting somewhere.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym, one of the Duskryn sisters, is sharply skeptical of Daz’s possible noble lineage, interpreting his mysterious value as typical orphan fantasy, and expresses irritation with the lack of clarity in their contract.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery... For all we know, this was a game being played by the houses.

subject: Nym Duskryn
fact: Nym Duskryn is a Drow mercenary from Menzoberranzan, hired to protect Daz from House Mizzrym and House T'sarran. She speaks with the tone of practiced courtesy that masks professional detachment. She dismissed the threat of a low-level Lolth cultist as irrelevant and emphasized that Daz’s survival was not her concern beyond contract terms.
source_quote: Our terms of our contract were to make sure that the other drow factions didn't get you killed.

subject: party member count
fact: Eight individuals emerged from the tunnel: the narrator, Thorin, Grygum, Daz, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and two others referred to as 'the rest of our moltley crew'.
source_quote: The others emerged around me. Thorin first... Grygum next... Daz came through last... The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: prisoner count
fact: A water-damaged journal from a prisoner we would never meet — someone who had written things down and then, presumably, stopped being able to.
source_quote: a prisoner we would never meet

subject: Protanther
fact: Protanther is referenced as the individual Stroud sat across from after four hundred years of preparation.
source_quote: I thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther. Four hundred years of preparation. Still had a blind spot.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait emerged from the tunnel as part of the group.
source_quote: The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait emerged with the rest of the surviving crew after Daz, part of the group who had survived this journey.
source_quote: The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is a surviving member of the group who emerged into the Overbright, noted only as part of the collective, with no individual actions or reactions described.
source_quote: The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: Stroud
fact: Stroud is referenced as having sat across from Protanther after four hundred years of preparation.
source_quote: I thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther. Four hundred years of preparation. Still had a blind spot.

subject: The Mage (House T'sarran)
fact: The deceased mage carried House T'sarran's signet ring and partially burned documents confirming a contract to extract Daz alive; she was likely the courier of the order and is now dead with the evidence on her person.
source_quote: The mage who'd been carrying those orders was now dead on the floor with a T'sarran ring on her finger.

subject: The Narrator
fact: The narrator, bearing an Eldritch Claw Tattoo, acted decisively when others hesitated. They moved unseen, delivered precise lethal strikes, and silenced Asha before she could speak again. They acknowledged their action as irreversible and refused to look at the body.
source_quote: I made it. That's all. I didn't look at the body.

subject: the tall one
fact: The tall one, whose name the speaker never caught, taught a class on material impermanence.
source_quote: I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.

subject: Thorin
fact: A prisoner whose tooth was taken as a trophy by Ilvara and later reclaimed — his quiet recognition of its significance revealing the personal cost of theological domination.
source_quote: Oh, yeah. I want my tooth back. He held it for a moment without saying anything. Then: 'Very sentimental.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin attempted to subdue Asha Vandree with a grapple, clamping his hand over her mouth to prevent spellcasting. His method was ineffective as a long-term solution, and he later claimed he could have killed her if he'd wanted to.
source_quote: I could have taken her out if I wanted to.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin carries Dawnbringer and is contemplating its nature after months of darkness; he mentioned a 'sword whisperer' as a specialist who might understand the blade's radiance, and he is calculating the sun's position relative to the year.
source_quote: Thorin stood with his face at an angle that suggested he was calculating the sun's position relative to the year.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin emerged first from the tunnel, as he always leads from the front — it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin emerged first from the tunnel.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin grapples Asha Vandree and covers her mouth to prevent her from casting spells.
source_quote: Thorin crossed the distance and got his hands on her — properly, a full grapple, one hand clamped over her mouth before she could invoke anything else.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin has that look he gets — the one where he's deciding whether to charge at the problem or stand very still and wait for it to explain itself.
source_quote: Thorin had that look he gets — the one where he's deciding whether to charge at the problem or stand very still and wait for it to explain itself.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who always leads from the front.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who carries the sentient sunblade Dawnbringer and has developed a patient, ritualized method of managing its objections using the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard.
source_quote: Do I need to show you the scabbard again?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a member of Daz’s party who attempted to retain the Duskryn sisters for continued protection. He asked directly about cost, but was met with an unyielding refusal that implied his group’s resources were insufficient.
source_quote: Thorin, to his credit, tried to retain them. He asked what it would cost.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a member of the party who attempted to subdue Asha Vandree via grapple, believing non-lethal restraint sufficient; his reluctance to kill reflects a moral code at odds with the lethal pragmatism of the Drow mercenaries.
source_quote: I don't like killing people if I don't have to.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is contemplating a sword whisperer to address the spiritual wear of Dawnbringer after months in the Underdark, and refuses to relinquish the blade, treating it as an extension of his identity.
source_quote: Thorin stood with his face at an angle that suggested he was calculating the sun's position relative to the year.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is known as Thorin Giantfriend.
source_quote: Thorin Giantfriend, radical transparency

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is thinking about Dawnbringer and its exposure to darkness.
source_quote: Thorin, characteristically, was thinking about Dawnbringer. Not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through. Months of darkness, months of the deep

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin mentioned a specialist called a 'sword whisperer'.
source_quote: He had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin reclaimed his tooth from Ilvara's possessions and acknowledged its sentimental value, though he said little after.
source_quote: 'Oh, yeah. I want my tooth back.' He reached in and found it. He held it for a moment without saying anything. Then: 'Very sentimental.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin retrieved his tooth from the confiscated prisoner belongings chest.
source_quote: He reached in and found it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was thinking about Dawnbringer — not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through.
source_quote: Thorin, characteristically, was thinking about Dawnbringer. Not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through.

subject: Thorin age
fact: Thorin had been a prisoner for fifteen years.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin Giantfriend possesses deep familiarity with Dawnbringer’s personality and maintains a stable, repetitive dynamic with the sentient sunblade, using the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard as a diplomatic tool.
source_quote: Do I need to show you the scabbard again?

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin Giantfriend practices radical transparency except when the thing being said wouldn't add anything to the next ten seconds, and chose silence in this moment.
source_quote: Thorin Giantfriend, radical transparency, except when the thing being said wouldn't add anything to the next ten seconds.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin Giantfriend recovered a necromantic pearl from the core of Ilvara's corrupted fungal ritual site and reclaimed his stolen tooth, marking the beginning and escalation of the corruption he and his party endured at Velkynvelve.
source_quote: Two objects. One that marked where we started, and one that marked how far the corruption had spread by the time we got here.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin carries Ilvara's recovered tooth as a marker of where they started.
source_quote: It was settled now. I had the tooth back. And I had the pearl that had been buried in the heart of whatever she'd turned this place into.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin carries the necromantic pearl as a marker of how far the corruption had spread by the time they arrived.
source_quote: I had the necromantic pearl in one pocket. I'd already turned over the question of what it meant — something this finished, this dense, at the core of a corrupted fungal mass that Ilvara had been using as a ritual anchor.

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: Velkynvelve is a location or event referenced by Daz as the starting point of his internal list of enemies.
source_quote: I'd been running a list in the back of my head since Velkynvelve — the kind of list you keep when your life depends on knowing who wants what.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes his action was true and reasonable, even if others' hesitations were also true.
source_quote: I just happened to also be true.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes someone had to make the call to kill Asha Vandree, and he was the one who did.
source_quote: Someone had to make the call. I made it. That's all.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a combat-trained individual with an Eldritch Claw Tattoo, trained in decisive action under moral uncertainty; he executed Asha Vandree without hesitation, believing someone had to make the call — and that he was the one who should.
source_quote: Someone had to make the call. I made it. That's all.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir took possession of Asha Vandree’s Drow cloak, a fine spider-silk garment that drinks shadow.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir took the Drow cloak from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir uses his Eldritch Claw Tattoo to kill Asha Vandree by striking her with precise, extended strikes.
source_quote: One moment I was behind her, the next my hands were something else — longer, reaching — and the strikes came in sequence, each one placed with the kind of precision that the monastery's combat drills were actually good for.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir, characteristically, was simply watching.
source_quote: Zalthir, characteristically, was simply watching.

subject: artifact age
fact: The artifact is a thousand-year-old relic.

subject: bag of holding
fact: Grygum opened the bag of holding.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding.

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: The Bag of Holding was opened by Grygum, allowing Glabbagool to emerge; it has survived Blingdenstone, the ooze crisis, and months of Underdark travel, and its contents remain unexplained.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze — had peered out.

subject: Bag of holding
fact: The bag of holding was used to transport Glabbagool safely through the Underdark, but its accidental opening exposed the ooze to sunlight for the first time, triggering a transformative reaction.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool... had peered out.

subject: bag of holding usage
fact: Grygum opened the bag of holding just enough for Glabbagool to peer out.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward... had peered out.

subject: Bond Payment
fact: The Duskryn sisters are operating under a bond system — they will be paid upon successful protection of Daz. If he dies, they risk losing their payment and facing consequences from their employer. This creates an implicit threat if Daz dies prematurely.
source_quote: If you haven't eliminated all the other factions, and I go and get myself killed in the next 15 minutes, and you guys go and collect on the bond, and then your employer finds out — it's not gonna be a good day for you.

subject: books
fact: To audit their books.
source_quote: To audit their books.

subject: chain mail
fact: Chain mail was looted from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: chain mail
fact: Chain mail was recovered from Asha Vandree's remains.
source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: Chain mail, prayer beads, and holy symbol of Lolth from Asha Vandree
fact: Standard clerical gear from a cleric who had become a vessel for rot — items now separated from their sacred context, reduced to loot.
source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: chest of coin
fact: A chest of coin containing Velkynvelve's operational budget in gold and silver was discovered.
source_quote: The payroll was next — a chest of coin, Velkynvelve's operational budget rendered in gold and silver.

subject: Cloth with Lolth-Zuggtmoy Sigil
fact: A stitched cloth bearing the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy’s mark interwoven with Lolth’s web, symbolizing Ilvara’s blasphemous fusion of two deities and her ritual corruption.
source_quote: A cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: cloth with sigils
fact: The cloth is stitched with Lolth's web woven inside the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark.
source_quote: a cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: contract payment value
fact: The contract to protect Daz required a significant financial expenditure, described as 'a lot' and involving interruptions.
source_quote: how much money that required us to get, for us to do? A lot. Like, they interrupt you. A lot.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: A sentient sunblade with strong aversion to being used in ritual purification, asserting its identity as a weapon of destruction, and responsive to the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard’s authority.
source_quote: I'm not some kind of magical wizard thingy that purifies things. I am a high-quality sunblade. I kill things.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is Thorin's sentient sword, forged for radiance but forced into prolonged darkness; Thorin believes it requires a 'sword whisperer' to understand its nature and is determined not to relinquish it.
source_quote: Thorin, characteristically, was thinking about Dawnbringer. Not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient blade forged for radiance, now worn by Thorin after enduring months of darkness in the Underdark, and is the subject of a quest to find a sword whisperer to restore its spiritual integrity.
source_quote: Thorin, characteristically, was thinking about Dawnbringer... months of darkness, months of the deep, a blade whose nature was radiance forced to endure the complete absence of the thing it was built to carry.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient sunblade that refuses to be used for ritual purification.
source_quote: Dawnbringer disagreed. 'I'm not some kind of magical wizard thingy that purifies things. I am a high-quality sunblade. I kill things.'

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sword that was exposed to months of darkness in the Underdark.
source_quote: Dawnbringer... a blade whose nature was radiance forced to endure the complete absence of the thing it was built to carry.

subject: Dawnbringer value
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient sunblade with strong opinions about its use.
source_quote: Dawnbringer is a weapon of radiant power. ... I'm not some kind of magical wizard thingy that purifies things. I am a high-quality sunblade. I kill things.

subject: documents
fact: The documents were partially burned but still legible in places.
source_quote: The documents. They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it

subject: Drow cloak

source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Drow cloak
fact: Drow cloaks disintegrate in sunlight.
source_quote: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: Drow cloak
fact: Zalthir took the Drow cloak made of fine spider-silk that drinks shadow from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Drow cloak of spider-silk from Asha Vandree
fact: A fine, shadow-absorbing garment taken by Zalthir — a relic of drow elegance now stripped of its wearer’s identity.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Drow cloaks
fact: Drow cloaks disintegrate upon exposure to sunlight, a known material impermanence taught in monastic curricula, which the group had prepared for by storing them in a bag.
source_quote: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: Drow cloak value
fact: Drow cloaks disintegrate in sunlight, implying their material value is tied to Underdark use.
source_quote: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: Drow cloak value
fact: The Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow —
source_quote: the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow

source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: Eldritch Claw Tattoo
fact: The Eldritch Claw Tattoo does not announce itself. It allows its bearer to move with supernatural precision, delivering strikes that are faster and more accurate than trained combat drills. It was used to silence Asha Vandree permanently.
source_quote: One moment I was behind her, the next my hands were something else — longer, reaching — and the strikes came in sequence...

subject: Eldritch Claw Tattoo
fact: Zalthir uses his Eldritch Claw Tattoo to deliver precise, extended strikes that kill Asha Vandree.
source_quote: The Eldritch Claw Tattoo doesn't announce itself. One moment I was behind her, the next my hands were something else — longer, reaching — and the strikes came in sequence...

subject: Extraction Contract
fact: The extraction contract is a document produced by Daz’s party that details the terms of an attempted operation. It was central to the Duskryn sisters’ assessment of the threats and served as evidence of Daz’s survival against House T'sarran’s agents.
source_quote: Kaelira gestured toward the scorched remnants of the extraction contract the party had produced — the document that had apparently been at the center of all this.

subject: Extraction Contract

subject: origin of the quest
fact: The thought had a particular shape. Elegant, in the way that retrospective clarity sometimes is. The whole of it — the capture, the escape, Velkynvelve, the months of running — threading back to a single point. Me. A nobody. A nobody that someone in Menzoberranzan had interrupted their schedule over, more than once.
source_quote: *for all you know, the reason this all got started was because they all decided to be friends with the wrong drow.*

subject: pre-craziness or post-craziness
fact: It is unresolved whether Asha Vandree's theological manuscript was written before or after her mind succumbed to madness.
source_quote: Is this pre-craziness or post-craziness, do you think?

subject: Stroud and Protanther reference
fact: The narrator recalled Stroud sitting across from Protanther as an example of a blind spot in long-term preparation.
source_quote: I thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther. Four hundred years of preparation. Still had a blind spot.

subject: sword whisperer
fact: Thorin believes a 'sword whisperer' exists — a specialist who can understand Dawnbringer's nature after its time in darkness — but no one knows who this person is or where to find them.
source_quote: He had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about, which meant he believed this person existed and should be found.

subject: The Burning Documents
fact: Partially burned documents recovered from the mage’s remains confirm the contract but lack full context, leaving gaps in understanding the motives, intermediaries, and ultimate goals behind Daz’s extraction.
source_quote: They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it.

subject: The class on material impermanence
fact: There was a class for this — some form of material impermanence — I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.
source_quote: There was a class for this. Some form of material impermanence — I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.

subject: The contracting party
fact: The identity of the unknown party that hired the Drow sisters to extract Daz remains concealed even from the mercenaries themselves, suggesting layers of deliberate opacity and high-stakes secrecy.
source_quote: The contracting party was unknown even to them.

subject: The contracting party behind House T'sarran
fact: The identity of the party who commissioned House T'sarran to extract Daz alive and unharmed remains unknown.
source_quote: The contracting party was unknown even to them.

subject: the contract's intermediaries
fact: The contract to extract Daz was arranged through cutouts with deliberate opacity.
source_quote: The contracting party was unknown even to them. They had come specifically for me, through layers of intermediaries arranged with the kind of deliberate opacity that costs serious coin to maintain.

subject: The Identity of the Paymaster
fact: The true identity of the patron who paid 'a lot' — enough to interrupt their schedule multiple times — remains unknown; the insulation around the transaction implies the payer fears exposure for reasons of illegality, embarrassment, or danger.
source_quote: In Menzoberranzan, that level of insulation around a financial transaction means exactly one thing: the payer has significant reason not to be associated with the purchase.

subject: the meaning of the Overbright
fact: The party's prolonged observation of the surface sky suggests an unspoken emotional or spiritual reckoning with light after prolonged darkness, but no one has the words to articulate what they feel.
source_quote: I watched him watch the sky. Whatever he made of it, I did not have the vocabulary to ask.

subject: The Meaning of the Three Bravos
fact: The three repeated 'bravos' from Kaelira after Daz’s actions signal professional irony — the third is never sincere — hinting that her praise masks suspicion, calculation, or hidden knowledge.
source_quote: Three *bravos*. I have found, as a general principle, that a third *bravo* is never sincere.

subject: The meaning of 'Very sentimental'
fact: Thorin’s quiet acceptance of his tooth’s return — and his use of the phrase — hints at a deeper emotional wound, one that survived theological and physical domination.
source_quote: He held it for a moment without saying anything. Then: 'Very sentimental.'

subject: The merchant Tongued by a bardic curse
fact: A past case of linguistic and psychological fragmentation — eerily similar to Ilvara’s marginalia — suggesting a pattern of external corruption manifesting as textual dissonance.
source_quote: I had seen something like this before, in a completely different context — a merchant I once knew who had been Tongued by a bardic curse...

subject: the necromantic pearl's origin
fact: The necromantic pearl was placed or grown in the fungal core under deliberate conditions.
source_quote: The pearl wasn't in the wrong place by accident. Someone had put something like it there, or something like it had grown there because the conditions were exactly right for it.

subject: The Necromantic Pearl's Origin
fact: The source of the necromantic pearl — whether grown under specific conditions or placed deliberately — is unknown, representing a deeper mystery tied to Ilvara’s rituals and the chamber’s corruption.
source_quote: A rock in the wrong place is just a rock. A rock in the right place is a wall. The pearl wasn't in the wrong place by accident.

subject: Theological subversion of Ilvara
fact: A slow, ambiguous corruption by Zuggtmoy, documented in marginalia and behavior, leaving uncertainty whether Ilvara knew she was losing herself — a case study in invisible subversion.
source_quote: I could not tell from the text whether she had known she wasn't resisting or whether she had genuinely believed she was still moving in her own direction.

subject: The origin of the contract
fact: The reason the contract to protect Daz was initiated is not specified in this session.
source_quote: For all you know, the reason this all got started was because they all decided to be friends with the wrong drow.

subject: The origin of the necromantic pearl
fact: The origin of the necromantic pearl — whether placed or grown — remains unexplained.
source_quote: Either answer was a problem that needed a name.

subject: The origin of the theological treatise
fact: The author of the wax pouch treatise remains unknown — but their mind was shaped by centuries of Lolthite theological contortion, now twisted into a new, heretical unity with Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Clerics of Lolth have been doing this kind of theological contortion for centuries; what was unusual here was the destination.

subject: The payer's identity
fact: The identity of the person who paid to protect Daz is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Someone in Menzoberranzan had spent generously — they interrupt you, a lot — to ensure that a male Drow apostate with no house affiliation and no apparent strategic value survived...

subject: The Price You Cannot Afford
fact: The Duskryn sisters refuse to disclose the cost of their services, stating it is a price Daz’s party 'cannot afford.' This implies either financial, moral, or metaphysical cost beyond coin — and that their employer’s payment is tied to something far more dangerous than gold.
source_quote: That is a fee... that is a price you cannot afford.

subject: The second hand in Ilvara's prayer book
fact: The marginalia may have been written by an external influence — or by Ilvara herself in a fractured state — raising the question of agency in theological corruption.
source_quote: Someone else had written in her prayer book. Or — she had written in it herself but in a state so altered that the handwriting had changed.

subject: The silence after 'Is this pre-craziness or post-craziness?'
fact: No one could answer — the distinction between theological corruption and madness had become indistinguishable, and the group had no framework to classify it.
source_quote: Is this pre-craziness or post-craziness, do you think?" I asked. No one answered with any certainty.

subject: the sword whisperer
fact: Thorin believes a specialist — a 'sword whisperer' — exists who can restore Dawnbringer’s spiritual resonance after its prolonged exposure to darkness, though no such figure has been confirmed, making this a speculative quest.
source_quote: The phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about.

subject: The Three Bravos
fact: The Duskryn sisters’ three 'bravos' after Daz’s survival are interpreted as insincere — a professional mask for disinterest. This behavioral detail suggests their engagement was purely contractual, not personal.
source_quote: Three *bravos*. I have found, as a general principle, that a third *bravo* is never sincere.

subject: the two hands in the marginalia
fact: The presence of two distinct handwriting styles in the prayer book suggests either a second entity inscribing itself into Ilvara’s mind, or Ilvara’s own fractured identity; the deeper mystery is whether the second hand was an external force or an internal collapse.
source_quote: Two hands because two minds had been working the same pen.

subject: the wax pouch’s contents
fact: The wax pouch remains unopened; its contents are unknown, but its inclusion among the other items implies it is a critical piece of evidence — possibly containing a final message, a curse, or a key to Ilvara’s last actions.
source_quote: The prayer book. The wax pouch. The sealed orders. The serpent scourge.

subject: Thorin's sword quest
fact: Thorin sought a 'sword whisperer' to tend to Dawnbringer after its months in darkness.
source_quote: he had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up

subject: Thorin's sword whisperer
fact: Thorin had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about, which meant he believed this person existed and should be found.
source_quote: He had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about, which meant he believed this person existed and should be found.

subject: Tongued merchant reference
fact: The narrator recalled a merchant once Tongued by a bardic curse whose correspondence mirrored Ilvara's marginalia.
source_quote: I had seen something like this before, in a completely different context — a merchant I once knew who had been Tongued by a bardic curse, whose correspondence from that period was eerily similar.

subject: Unknown Employer
fact: An unknown party in Menzoberranzan paid a substantial sum to contract the Duskryn sisters to protect Daz. The identity, motives, and resources of this employer remain concealed, creating a persistent narrative thread of intrigue.
source_quote: Someone had paid for this. Someone who knew I was here, knew who was hunting me, and knew enough to contract professionals rather than handle it directly.

subject: why Daz is being protected
fact: Someone in Menzoberranzan paid a large sum to protect Daz anonymously, suggesting the reason is embarrassing, illegal, or dangerous.
source_quote: In Menzoberranzan, that level of insulation around a financial transaction means exactly one thing: the payer has significant reason not to be associated with the purchase.

subject: after Stroud beats Protanther at chess
fact: The event of Stroud beating Protanther at chess serves as a temporal anchor that reconfigured academic priorities, making previously obscure studies suddenly urgent and relevant.
source_quote: And then Stroud beat Protanther at chess.

subject: dusk
fact: The time of day is dusk — a specific temporal anchor that defines the tactical vulnerability of the party. It is not a date, but a critical moment in the cycle of light and shadow that determines the stakes of the encounter.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: I did not rule it out.

subject: Four hundred years of analysis
fact: The duration of Protanther’s chess analysis — four centuries — represents an immense investment in certainty that was ultimately undone by a single, uncalculated act, underscoring the theme that preparation alone cannot predict divine alignment.
source_quote: an ancient gold dragon who had been analyzing the same position for four hundred years.

subject: Post-Blindstone Escape
fact: The events occur after the target's escape from the Underdark and a period of minimal rest in Blingdenstone, establishing a timeline of vulnerability and transition.
source_quote: running on whatever sleep we'd managed in Blingdenstone

subject: road to Candlekeep
fact: The journey to Candlekeep spanned weeks of psychological warfare, misinformation, and the transformation of the drow spy from a threat into a confined, mocked, and surveilled object — a period during which Glabbagool’s quiet, unblinking attention became the most stable and earnest force in the party.

subject: Session Anchor
fact: The events described occur during an active journey toward Candlekeep, with no specific calendar date given, but framed as immediate and ongoing.
source_quote: I have found purpose. I am the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard. This is fine.

subject: session date
fact: The events occur immediately following the conclusion of a long journey through the Underdark, with no specific calendar date given — the temporal anchor is the moment of emergence into sunlight.
source_quote: Months underground. Months of bioluminescence...

subject: Session Date
fact: The events of the interrogation occur during a session following the party’s prolonged time in the Underdark, after multiple ambushes and chases that have honed their instincts for surveillance and betrayal.
source_quote: Months in the Underdark will calibrate your instincts. You learn to notice the shape of a threat before you can name it.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The dusk settled around us. North of the road, something that was not a deer held its position and waited.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the third day of open sky after emerging from the Underdark.
source_quote: The third day of open sky and I still hadn't stopped scanning.

subject: the day the drow spy was captured
fact: The day the party encountered and captured a drow agent on the surface — a turning point that shifted their understanding of their own danger. No longer were they merely fugitives; they were pawns in a centuries-old game. The date is marked by the first time Daz was recognized not as a member of the party, but as a target of a hidden agenda. It is the day the mystery of his patron was revealed to exist.
source_quote: The stun wore off and she was already calculating.

subject: the road to Candlekeep
fact: The journey to Candlekeep spanned days of travel, during which the party’s deception, knowledge manipulation, and existential questions coalesced — a period of reflection that transformed the act of entry into a ritual of revelation.
source_quote: I thought about it for the better part of the road to Candlekeep — what a creature with no past and no allegiances and a singular earnest interest in understanding the world would choose to know.

subject: Third day of open sky
fact: The third day of open sky marks a transitional phase in psychological adaptation, where lingering Underdark instincts begin to soften but do not vanish.
source_quote: The third day of open sky and I still hadn't stopped scanning.

subject: Third day of open sky
